versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Hooked Video API skill.

- Create AI-powered videos from scripts or prompts, UGC ads, or TikTok slideshows
- Browse and select avatars, voices, and background music
- Check video status, download completed videos, and list recent projects
- Discover trending video content by platform and niche
- Webhook support for video completion events
- Includes pricing details, rate limits, and error handling information
